positions.name: PallasineOnboardingMandate
positions.frame: how does the Pallasine checklist function as the governing onboarding procedure for new hires?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under a shared authority-ranking and conservation read: src-1 states the universal mandate and its three required components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift), while src-2 grounds the checklist's institutional authority by noting it superseded the old wiki page. The directional observations converge on legitimate power, conservation of process stability, and concrete realis delivery across both — one present-tense rule, one past-tense institutional history, both performing the same ratified-procedure stance.
